description: UPC validation rules learned from production corrections

criticalRules.name: brand_prefix_match
criticalRules.description: UPC prefix must match product brand

criticalRules.name: weight_tolerance
criticalRules.description: Weight must be within 5% or 0.5oz (whichever is larger)

warningRules.name: color_mismatch
warningRules.description: Colors should match but can be variant products

same_brand_different_product.description: Products from same brand assigned same UPC
examples: Zoo Med Calcium 3.2oz vs Zoo Med Calcium + D3 3.2oz
Exo Terra Ceramic 100w vs Exo Terra Ceramic 150w
Coastal Harness Small vs Coastal Harness Medium

species_category_mismatch.description: Dog/cat product UPC assigned to reptile/fish product
examples: Fieldcrest Farms dog chew with Lees turtle lagoon UPC
Tuesday's dog treats with Tetra reptile food UPC
species_category_mismatch.prevention: Check species keywords in product names

leading_zero_stripped.description: Excel import strips leading zeros from UPCs
leading_zero_stripped.prevention: Always validate 12-digit format, prepend 0 if needed
